title.en: Stale in_progress runs auto-cancel after VULYK_STALE_RUN_TTL_HOURS
title.uk: Застарілі in_progress прогони автоскасовуються після VULYK_STALE_RUN_TTL_HOURS
title.fr: Les runs in_progress obsolètes sont auto-annulés après VULYK_STALE_RUN_TTL_HOURS
title.es: Los runs in_progress obsoletos se cancelan tras VULYK_STALE_RUN_TTL_HOURS
title.de: Veraltete in_progress-Runs werden nach VULYK_STALE_RUN_TTL_HOURS auto-abgebrochen

description.en: Job worker + list/get lazy path mark inactive in_progress/running runs as cancelled after the TTL (default 24h).
description.uk: Job worker і lazy-шлях list/get позначають неактивні in_progress/running як cancelled після TTL (типово 24 год).
description.fr: Job worker + list/get lazy path mark inactive in_progress/running runs as cancelled after the TTL (default 24h).
description.es: Job worker + list/get lazy path mark inactive in_progress/running runs as cancelled after the TTL (default 24h).
description.de: Job worker + list/get lazy path mark inactive in_progress/running runs as cancelled after the TTL (default 24h).

precondition.en: API with VULYK_STALE_RUN_TTL_HOURS set; an in_progress run older than the TTL.
precondition.uk: API з VULYK_STALE_RUN_TTL_HOURS; in_progress прогін старіший за TTL.
precondition.fr: API with VULYK_STALE_RUN_TTL_HOURS set; an in_progress run older than the TTL.
precondition.es: API with VULYK_STALE_RUN_TTL_HOURS set; an in_progress run older than the TTL.
precondition.de: API with VULYK_STALE_RUN_TTL_HOURS set; an in_progress run older than the TTL.

action.en: Create an in_progress run, backdate updated_at past the TTL, run expire_stale_in_progress_runs.
action.uk: Створити in_progress прогін, зсунути updated_at за TTL, викликати expire_stale_in_progress_runs.
action.fr: Create an in_progress run, backdate updated_at past the TTL, run expire_stale_in_progress_runs.
action.es: Create an in_progress run, backdate updated_at past the TTL, run expire_stale_in_progress_runs.
action.de: Create an in_progress run, backdate updated_at past the TTL, run expire_stale_in_progress_runs.

expected_result.en: Run status is cancelled; meta.cancel_reason is stale_ttl.
expected_result.fr: Run status is cancelled; meta.cancel_reason is stale_ttl.
expected_result.es: Run status is cancelled; meta.cancel_reason is stale_ttl.
expected_result.de: Run status is cancelled; meta.cancel_reason is stale_ttl.
